title: Sound speed and the conditions for sound propagation
query: Using the supplied GLORYS12 monthly temperature, salinity and mixed-layer thickness for 2011-2020 off California and Oregon (30-48 N, 130-116 W), compute the sound-speed field and determine how the depth of the sound-speed minimum, the near-surface sound-speed gradient and the occurrence of a surface duct vary across the region, through the seasons and from year to year, and whether temperature, salinity or pressure controls those variations. The fields end at 1000 m and are monthly means; state what this prevents you from concluding.
